more.title: Rand gains slightly as traders await budget speech, inflation data
more.description: The South African rand edged up in early trade on Monday as investors looked ahead to a key week for economic data, including Finance Minister Enoch Godongwana’s medium-term budget policy statement and September inflation figures.• At 0548 GMT the rand traded at 16.4475, up roughly 0.2% from its previous close• Investor focus is expected to centre on Wednesday’s medium-term budget policy statement, which could offer fresh clues on South Africa’s fiscal trajectory amid expectations of an improving budget balance and a more favourable sovereign ratings outlook• Statistics...
